title: Remote ML Engineer
description_html:
Turing, headquartered in San Francisco, California, is a leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. The company supports its customers by accelerating cutting-edge research through high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, and top AI researchers specializing in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents. Additionally, Turing helps enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence, delivering reliable systems that create measurable impact and drive lasting results on the bottom line.

We are seeking experienced Machine Learning Engineers to join our team and contribute to benchmark-driven evaluation projects focused on real-world machine learning systems. This role requires hands-on experience with production-grade ML codebases, model training and evaluation pipelines, and deployment workflows. The ideal candidate will bridge research and engineering by working deeply with models, data, and infrastructure in realistic machine learning environments.

Key Responsibilities:
- Work with real-world ML codebases to support MLE Bench–style evaluation tasks.
- Build, run, and modify model training, evaluation, and inference pipelines.
- Prepare datasets, features, and metrics for ML benchmarking and validation.
- Debug, refactor, and improve production-like ML systems to enhance correctness and performance.
- Evaluate model behavior, failure modes, and edge cases relevant to benchmark tasks.
- Write clean, reproducible, and well-documented Python code for ML workflows.
- Participate in code reviews to maintain high engineering standards.
- Collaborate with researchers and engineers to design challenging, real-world ML engineering tasks for AI system evaluation.

Required Qualifications:
- Minimum of 3 years of experience as a Machine Learning Engineer or Software Engineer with an ML focus.
- Strong proficiency in Python for machine learning and data workflows.
- Hands-on experience with model training, evaluation, and inference pipelines.
- Solid understanding of machine learning fundamentals including supervised and unsupervised learning, evaluation metrics, and optimization techniques.
- Experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, or similar.
- Ability to understand, navigate, and modify complex, real-world ML codebases.
- Proven ability to write readable, reusable, and maintainable production-quality code.
- Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
- Excellent spoken and written English communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits:
- Work remotely in a fully flexible environment.
- Opportunity to engage with cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading companies in the large language model space.
- Contractor engagement requiring a minimum commitment of 4 hours per day and 20 hours per week, with at least 4 hours overlapping with Pacific Standard Time (PST).
- Contract duration is initially 3 months, with potential adjustments based on engagement.
- Note that this is a contractor role without medical benefits or paid leave.

Evaluation Process:
Candidates will undergo a technical interview featuring a 60-minute live coding challenge to assess their skills and suitability for the role.

title: Machine Learning Operations Engineer (AI/ML) - Remote - Pakistan
description_html:
FullStack is an AI-native engineering partner dedicated to transforming AI capabilities into reliable, production-ready solutions. Unlike many companies that only demonstrate AI concepts, FullStack specializes in integrating AI into products from the ground up, supported by elite, vetted talent and transparent execution that delivers measurable value. Serving over 600 customers across North America, FullStack acts as a single, integrated partner for all AI engineering needs, empowering clients to advance with confidence.

Key Responsibilities
As a Machine Learning Operations Engineer (AI/ML), you will join our talent network and collaborate directly with U.S.-based clients on flexible, project-based assignments. You will integrate seamlessly into client teams, working alongside designers and engineers daily to deploy and maintain machine learning models in production environments. Your role will involve implementing MLOps best practices such as model tracking, versioning, monitoring, and lifecycle management. You will contribute to continuous integration and delivery workflows, troubleshoot complex issues, and enhance existing libraries and systems. Ownership of your work and alignment with client goals will be essential to your success.

Required Qualifications
- Minimum of 3 years of professional software development experience focused on Machine Learning and MLOps practices.
- Advanced proficiency in English.
- Completion of a four-year college degree.
- Demonstrated experience deploying ML and AI models to production via APIs or endpoints.
- Practical knowledge of MLOps including model lifecycle management, tracking, and monitoring.
- Hands-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs) or Generative AI concepts and integrations.
- Strong understanding of infrastructure and systems, including containerization, cloud platforms, and CI/CD workflows.
- Proficiency in Python programming for ML development, automation, and production applications.
- Familiarity with ML lifecycle tools such as MLflow or data platforms like Databricks, Snowflake, Spark, or BigQuery is advantageous.
- Experience with agentic workflows, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), LangChain, or LangGraph is a plus.
- Ability to work independently on complex problems and contribute to code libraries.
- Detail-oriented with a forensic approach to quality and accuracy.
- Positive attitude with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
- Experience working within Agile/Scrum teams.
- Proven ability to manage large, complex systems and meet agreed-upon performance standards.
- Commitment to understanding and delivering on client objectives.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits
Candidates enthusiastic about AI integration in their workflows will find additional value in experience with tools such as Cursor, Windsurf, Google Antigravity, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, or Copilot CLI.

FullStack offers competitive compensation, 100% remote work opportunities, and the chance to collaborate with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies. We support continuous education and provide pathways for career growth and skill expansion.

We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible environment where IT professionals from all backgrounds can find opportunities that match their skills. Our recruitment process emphasizes fairness, transparency, and respect for diverse perspectives and global collaboration.

Applicants must be authorized to work full-time in the country of the job posting, as FullStack does not sponsor work visas now or in the future.

title: Data Integration and Machine Learning Engineer
description_html:
This role is essential to the success of our AI initiatives, focusing on ensuring the quality and availability of enterprise data, effective problem formulation, and reliable model training. The Integration and Machine Learning Engineer will work to guarantee that data from multiple systems is accurate, complete, and ready for use. This position involves integrating data across internal and external platforms and developing production-grade machine learning solutions that generate tangible business value.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design and implement AI solutions integrated with ERP, cloud, ECM, IoT, and DCS systems.
- Build and maintain APIs and data pipelines to support reliable AI and ML adoption.
- Prepare enterprise data for AI agents using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, and vector databases.
- Embed security by design principles throughout data integration, AI, and ML processes.
- Establish scalable data mesh architecture incorporating metadata management, data lineage, and thorough documentation.
- Collaborate closely with IT and business teams to define machine learning problems, establish baselines, select metrics, and validate models.
- Develop and deploy ML models for forecasting, optimization, and other business-critical use cases.
- Apply statistical methods and feature engineering techniques with leakage-free validation and model explainability.

Required Qualifications:
- 3 to 5 years of experience in data engineering, machine learning, or integration roles, preferably within manufacturing or ERP-driven industries.
- Proven hands-on experience working with ERP, cloud platforms, ECM, or similar enterprise applications and managing production data pipelines.
- Demonstrated end-to-end experience in developing, deploying, and monitoring machine learning solutions.
- Experience with forecasting, optimization, or recommendation systems is considered an advantage.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Proficiency in programming languages and tools such as SQL, Python, PL/SQL, Apache Airflow, Talend, and REST APIs.
- Familiarity with machine learning and statistical libraries including scikit-learn, pandas, XGBoost, or equivalents; expertise in regression, classification, clustering, time-series forecasting, anomaly detection, model evaluation, and optimization using OR-Tools, Pyomo, or similar frameworks.
- Experience working with systems and databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, AWS/Azure Data Lake, and NoSQL databases.
- Knowledge of data management practices including data cataloging, validation frameworks, and observability tools.

This position offers the opportunity to contribute directly to impactful AI and ML projects by ensuring data integrity and delivering scalable, secure, and effective machine learning solutions across enterprise systems.

title: AI Engineer | Pakistan
description_html:
Volga Partners is seeking an experienced AI Engineer to join our Engineering team in Islamabad, Pakistan. This hybrid role requires working three days in the office and two days remotely, with working hours from 7:00 PM to 4:00 AM PKT. The AI Engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying advanced AI systems, including large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) frameworks, agentic workflows, and intelligent automation solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in model training, research-to-production skills, and the ability to integrate AI technologies into scalable applications for global clients. This position reports directly to Product and Engineering Leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and deploy AI systems such as LLMs, RAG frameworks, agentic workflows, and machine learning/deep learning solutions. Select suitable models and architectures by balancing accuracy, latency, cost, and complexity. Train and fine-tune models using frameworks like PyTorch or Keras, including data preparation and evaluation. Implement and benchmark research methods before adoption, and develop APIs, inference pipelines, and backend integrations.

Own evaluation metrics to monitor quality, latency, and cost. Debug, optimize, and maintain AI systems post-launch to ensure production readiness and prevent regressions. Collaborate closely with software engineers, product teams, and leadership to integrate AI into applications. Participate in technical discussions, decision-making, and document architecture, implementation approaches, and key technical decisions.

Stay current with ML research by reading and evaluating papers, implementing promising methods, and reproducing results where applicable. Adapt emerging techniques into production-ready systems and contribute to ongoing innovation across AI and engineering initiatives.

Required Qualifications

A minimum of 3 years of hands-on AI/ML engineering experience, with at least one system deployed to production. Strong fundamentals in natural language processing (NLP), including tokenization, embeddings, classification, named entity recognition (NER), and information extraction. Proficient engineering skills in coding, version control (Git), testing, API and system design, and debugging. Hands-on experience training models using PyTorch or Keras.

Understanding of generative model architectures such as Transformers and variational autoencoders (VAEs). Production experience with LLMs, including RAG, embeddings/vector databases, and prompt/evaluation design. Familiarity with FastAPI or similar frameworks, Docker, and at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Ability to read and translate ML research papers into working code.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits

Experience with LLM fine-tuning techniques, including LoRA and reinforcement learning-based methods. Knowledge of SQL databases and familiarity with agent frameworks like LangGraph or LangChain. Experience with Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and model-serving infrastructure. Contributions to open-source projects or experience reproducing research results is a plus.

The monthly salary ranges from PKR 150,000 to PKR 400,000, commensurate with experience and expertise. Employment will be managed through Volga Partners with contract and payment administration facilitated via Deel. A 90-day probationary period applies, after which employees become eligible for company-sponsored medical insurance, paid time off according to company policy, holiday pay for observed holidays, and opportunities for career growth within Volga Partners’ expanding AI-focused organization.

Our Hiring Process

The recruitment process begins with an initial video call with a recruiter to discuss your background, experience, career goals, and salary expectations. Successful candidates will then complete a practical skills assessment asynchronously, designed to evaluate technical knowledge and problem-solving abilities. Submissions are reviewed against the role’s technical requirements, and qualified candidates advance to a final interview with the Chief Technology Officer. This interview focuses on technical alignment, architectural thinking, problem-solving, and overall fit with the team and role.

title: Software AI Engineer
description_html:
We are seeking a skilled and experienced Software AI Engineer to design, develop, deploy, and maintain scalable Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Python programming, machine learning algorithms, deep learning frameworks, cloud platforms, and production-grade model deployment. This role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to develop intelligent applications, optimize model performance, and seamlessly integrate AI/ML solutions into existing systems and business workflows.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design, develop, train, and optimize machine learning and deep learning models for real-world applications.
- Build AI/ML pipelines covering data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and inference.
- Develop AI-powered applications using Python and relevant AI/ML libraries and frameworks.
- Implement Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions as needed.
- Deploy, monitor, and maintain production-ready AI/ML models on cloud platforms.
- Develop scalable APIs and backend services using FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
- Apply MLOps practices for model versioning, monitoring, testing, and deployment automation.
- Optimize model performance, scalability, reliability, and cloud resource utilization.
- Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and provide technical guidance to junior engineers.

Required Qualifications:
- Minimum of 2+ years of professional experience in AI/ML engineering, machine learning, or a related field.
- Strong proficiency in Python and libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, and Scikit-learn.
- Hands-on experience with AI/ML and deep learning frameworks including PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Keras.
- Solid understanding of machine learning algorithms, deep learning techniques, feature engineering, model evaluation, and hyperparameter tuning.
- Experience with at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
- Practical experience deploying AI/ML models into production environments.
- Knowledge of containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes, along with CI/CD pipelines and model-serving technologies.
- Familiarity with MLOps tools such as MLflow or Kubeflow.
- Experience developing RESTful APIs using FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
- Working knowledge of SQL, databases, version control with Git, automated testing, and monitoring tools.

- Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is highly desirable.

This position offers the opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI technologies within a collaborative environment, contributing to impactful projects that integrate advanced machine learning solutions into business-critical systems.

description_html:
The Data Scientist at Pta plays a critical role in analyzing complex data sets to reveal actionable insights that drive strategic decisions. This position requires strong expertise in machine learning, statistical analysis, and data visualization, and involves working with large volume data using tools like Python, R, and SQL. The role demands proficiency with data manipulation libraries such as Pandas and NumPy, and experience in designing interactive dashboards using Tableau and Power BI. The Data Scientist collaborates with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into data-driven solutions, improving processes and outcomes through evidence-based decision making. This is an entry-level position requiring at least one year of relevant experience, with no team management responsibilities. In this role, the Data Scientist applies advanced analytical techniques including hypothesis testing and deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, Keras, and PyTorch to develop predictive models and neural networks. They ensure data integrity through rigorous data transformation and conduct statistical hypothesis testing to validate business assumptions. The role emphasizes continuous learning and adaptation of new data science methods and tools to keep pace with technological advancements. title: Technical Project Manager
description_html:
SiliconNexus is a fast-growing technology company specializing in Embedded Systems, Blockchain, AI/ML, and Web & Mobile Application Development. We pride ourselves on fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. Our teams work together to deliver impactful products and services to clients worldwide. We are currently looking for a Technical Project Manager to lead international software development projects, ensuring successful delivery within scope, time, and budget. This role requires strong technical knowledge, strategic thinking, and leadership skills, as well as the ability to manage client relationships effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Project Leadership: Oversee the full lifecycle of multiple software development projects, from planning through execution to delivery.

Team Coordination: Assign tasks, monitor progress, and facilitate smooth collaboration among development, design, and QA teams.

Client Communication: Serve as the primary liaison for clients, translating their business needs into clear technical requirements.

Risk & Issue Management: Proactively identify risks, resolve blockers, and adjust plans to keep projects on track.

Budget & Timeline Control: Manage project scope, timelines, and budgets to meet agreed-upon deliverables.

Quality Oversight: Ensure all deliverables meet quality standards through thorough reviews, testing, and stakeholder validation.

Reporting & Documentation: Maintain transparent progress updates and comprehensive project documentation.

Required Qualifications

Experience: 2–3 years of proven experience managing software development projects.

Technical Understanding: Familiarity with software development lifecycles, web and mobile technologies, and integration practices.

Project Management Tools: Hands-on experience with tools such as JIRA, Trello, Asana, or ClickUp.

Methodologies: Strong knowledge of Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall project management methodologies.

Client-Facing Skills: Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management abilities.

Leadership: Demonstrated ability to motivate teams, manage resources efficiently, and drive accountability.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits

Certifications: PMP, CSM, or other relevant project management certifications are preferred.

Compensation and Perks: Competitive salary with performance-based benefits, fuel and medical allowances, and flexible working hours to support work-life balance.

Career Growth: Opportunities for professional development and certifications within a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive work environment.

If you are passionate about leading technology projects and driving innovation, we encourage you to apply and join our dynamic team.

title: Social Media Manager
description_html:
Erha Technologies, founded in 2021, is a forward-thinking AI and machine learning agency specializing in building AI agents, intelligent chatbots, custom large language models (LLMs), and agentic automation solutions. The company utilizes advanced tools like n8n to help startups and enterprises reduce manual tasks and optimize digital workflows. With a strong focus on scalable, data-driven products, Erha Technologies aims to enhance operational efficiency and user experience. Team members work closely with clients to design and implement AI solutions tailored to their specific business requirements.

The Social Media Manager role is a full-time, on-site position based in Multan. Daily activities include managing social media calendars, drafting and editing posts, coordinating with design teams for visuals, and optimizing content to maximize reach and engagement. - Engage with the online community by responding to comments, messages, and interactions in a timely and professional manner.
- Collaborate closely with marketing and product teams to support promotional campaigns, product launches, and thought leadership content.
- Stay updated on social media trends, tools, and best practices relevant to AI, automation, and technology sectors.

Required Qualifications

- Excellent communication and writing skills, with the ability to craft clear, compelling, and brand-consistent messaging.
- Strong content strategy skills to plan campaigns, align content with business objectives, and maintain a consistent brand voice.
- Experience managing social media accounts for technology, SaaS, or AI-focused organizations is highly advantageous.
- Proficiency in interpreting social media analytics and using scheduling and management tools to optimize campaigns.
- Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, on-site environment with cross-functional teams.

This role offers the opportunity to contribute to a dynamic and innovative company at the forefront of AI and automation technologies. The Social Media Manager will play a critical part in shaping the company’s digital presence and engaging a growing audience interested in cutting-edge tech solutions.

title: AI Engineer
description_html:
Beghou Consulting brings over 30 years of expertise in helping life sciences companies enhance their commercialization efforts through strategic insights, advanced analytics, and cutting-edge technology. The company supports clients by developing go-to-market strategies, building foundational data analytics infrastructures, and leveraging artificial intelligence to deepen customer insights and engagement. Beghou also implements proprietary and third-party technology solutions that assist companies in forecasting performance, designing territories, managing customer data, and organizing and reporting on medical and commercial information. Headquartered in Evanston, Illinois, Beghou operates from 10 global offices with a mission to unite analytical minds and innovative technology to help life sciences companies navigate healthcare complexities and improve patient outcomes.

Key Responsibilities
- Build and deploy AI features focused on document understanding, structured data extraction, and review workflows.
- Develop robust pipelines that integrate language models with application logic, validation processes, and human review.
- Design evaluation frameworks using representative examples, labeled datasets, and clear quality metrics.
- Enhance output quality through techniques such as prompting, retrieval, model selection, and structured generation.
- Implement safeguards to handle uncertain, incomplete, or conflicting input data.
- Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and domain experts to translate workflow requirements into effective AI capabilities.
- Partner with engineering teams to integrate AI services into APIs, background jobs, and customer-facing applications.
- Monitor production environments for quality, latency, and cost, using insights to drive continuous improvements.
- Document system behaviors, limitations, and operational considerations to support transparency and maintainability.

Required Qualifications
- 5 to 8 years of engineering experience, including hands-on development and deployment of applied AI or machine learning products.
- Practical experience using language models to support real-world product workflows.
- Strong proficiency in Python and experience building production-grade services or data pipelines.
- Ability to evaluate model outputs using measurable criteria rather than anecdotal evidence.
- Familiarity with structured output formats, tool integration, retrieval methods, and validation techniques.
- Sound judgment regarding model uncertainty and determining when human review is necessary.
- Capability to navigate ambiguous problems and communicate technical trade-offs clearly.
- Solid software engineering fundamentals, including testing, observability, and maintainable system design.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits
- Experience with Document AI, information extraction, OCR, or transforming unstructured business documents into structured data.
- Knowledge of large language model (LLM) evaluation, dataset curation, human-in-the-loop systems, and regression testing.
- Familiarity with FastAPI, PostgreSQL, cloud infrastructure, and background processing technologies.
- Understanding of privacy considerations, data handling best practices, and production monitoring for AI features.

At Beghou Consulting, you will join a collaborative and values-driven team that prioritizes technical excellence, analytical rigor, and personal growth. Whether your passion lies in AI innovation, commercialization strategy, or developing data-first solutions for life sciences, this role offers a meaningful opportunity to make a significant impact.

Please note that artificial intelligence tools may be used during the hiring process to assist with application review, resume analysis, and response assessment. These tools support the recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are made by human evaluators.

title: Principal Data Engineer - II
description_html:
We are seeking an experienced Data Engineer to design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest, transform, and integrate data from diverse sources. The ideal candidate will implement both real-time data streaming and batch processing solutions to meet various business requirements. This role involves building and optimizing data storage solutions such as data lakes, warehouses, and databases while ensuring systems are scalable, secure, and high-performing. You will collaborate closely with Data Scientists, Analysts, and cross-functional teams to define data needs and deliver robust solutions that support analytics and machine learning initiatives.

Key Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines for data ingestion, transformation, and integration from multiple sources.
- Implement real-time streaming and batch processing solutions tailored to business needs.
- Build and optimize data storage architectures, including data lakes, warehouses, and databases.
- Ensure data systems and pipelines are scalable, secure, and performant to support growing data demands.
- Clean, transform, and prepare raw data into formats suitable for analytics and machine learning models.
- Collaborate with Data Scientists and Analysts to understand data requirements and deliver effective solutions.
- Monitor pipeline and system performance, proactively identifying and implementing improvements.
- Troubleshoot and resolve data-related issues promptly to minimize downtime.
- Implement and enforce data quality checks, validation processes, and monitoring mechanisms.
- Work alongside Data Governance teams to ensure compliance with organizational data standards and policies.
- Partner with Data Architects, Analysts, and business teams to gather requirements and deliver data solutions.
- Provide technical expertise and guidance on data engineering best practices.
- Stay current with emerging tools, technologies, and industry trends to continuously enhance data engineering capabilities.
- Evaluate and recommend new technologies to improve data infrastructure and processes.

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
- 7 to 8 years of professional experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar role, with a strong background in building and maintaining data pipelines and infrastructure.
- Hands-on experience with big data tools, cloud platforms, and data integration techniques.
- Expertise in SQL and proficiency working with both relational and NoSQL databases.
- Experience with data orchestration tools such as ODI, SSIS, Apache Airflow, dbt, or Prefect.
- Proficiency in programming languages including Python, Java, or Scala.
- Familiarity with data processing frameworks like Apache Spark and Kafka.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent communication and collaboration abilities, capable of working effectively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits
- Competitive salary package.
- Fuel card allowance.
- Comprehensive health benefits.
- Opportunities for professional development and continuous learning.
- Inclusive and supportive work culture fostering growth and innovation.

This role offers the chance to work with cutting-edge technologies and contribute to building scalable data solutions that drive business success. If you are passionate about data engineering and eager to collaborate with diverse teams, we encourage you to apply.

- Clear, professional communication suitable for engagements with U.S.-based clients.

- Excellent interpersonal, presentation, and professional communication skills.
- Confidence and professionalism when interacting with U.S.-based clients and technical stakeholders.
- Strong active listening, problem-solving, and relationship-building abilities.
- Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Calm and effective handling of challenging technical discussions.
- Strong teamwork, adaptability, and collaboration skills.

- At least 1 year of direct experience working with U.S.-based clients, preferably in AI/ML, software engineering, or technical consulting.

- Previous experience in client-facing technical interviews, presales engineering, solution architecture, or technical consulting.
- Production experience with multi-agent AI systems, enterprise LLM applications, or AI workflow automation.
- Familiarity with AWS Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry, Google Vertex AI, MLOps, and LLMOps.
- Proven ability to contribute to successful client engagements and project acquisition.

Shortlisted candidates will undergo a comprehensive assessment including experience review, live English communication evaluation, technical interviews covering software architecture and AI expertise, client interview simulations to assess communication and professionalism, and a final management interview to evaluate teamwork and cultural fit.

The position offers a competitive monthly salary ranging from Rs13,000,000 to Rs14,000,000.

title: AI Instructor (3 Month Contract)
description_html:
Edversity, a part of the Rapidev Group of Companies, is seeking an AI Instructor for a 3-month onsite contract position based in Faisalabad. This role involves delivering practical, industry-focused IT training through physical classes aimed at preparing young individuals for careers and freelancing opportunities in technology. The instructor will teach Artificial Intelligence skills ranging from Python fundamentals to building Generative AI applications. The position requires leading daily lectures and hands-on labs, guiding trainees through real AI projects to help them build strong portfolios. Working hours are from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

Key Responsibilities
- Deliver daily lectures and practical lab sessions following the approved curriculum.
- Simplify complex AI concepts into clear, manageable steps suitable for trainees with no prior AI experience.
- Prepare comprehensive lesson plans, slides, notebooks, assignments, and quizzes.
- Guide trainees through mini-projects and a final capstone project to demonstrate their learning.
- Monitor attendance, assess trainee progress, and submit regular reports to the program team.
- Conduct additional support sessions for trainees needing extra help.
- Continuously update course materials to incorporate the latest AI tools and suggest improvements.
- Advise trainees on building portfolios, maintaining GitHub profiles, and exploring job or freelancing opportunities.
- Assist with assessments, audits, and program reviews to ensure quality and effectiveness.

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
- 3 to 5 years of professional experience in AI/ML or AI application development.
- Proficiency in Python, including libraries such as Pandas and Scikit-learn; working knowledge of TensorFlow or PyTorch is essential.
- Hands-on experience with large language model APIs, LangChain or LlamaIndex frameworks, and vector databases.
- Experience deploying at least one AI model or application in a real-world environment.
- Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly in both English and Urdu.
- Patience and a genuine passion for teaching beginners and helping them build confidence.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits
- A public GitHub repository or portfolio showcasing AI projects.
- Relevant certifications such as TensorFlow Developer, Azure AI Engineer, or AWS Machine Learning.
- Previous experience in teaching, training, or mentoring roles is highly desirable.

The role offers a competitive monthly salary commensurate with experience. It provides a unique opportunity to influence the careers of young tech enthusiasts while working within a professional and collaborative team environment. Additionally, there is potential for growth within the Rapidev Group, making this an excellent position for those passionate about education and AI technology.

- Proven experience in data processing, analysis, and working with model-related workflows.
- Solid understanding of machine learning fundamentals and data science principles.
- Hands-on experience handling both structured and unstructured data formats.
- Ability to comprehend, navigate, and modify complex, real-world codebases effectively.
- Skilled in writing readable, reusable, maintainable, and well-documented code.
- Strong problem-solving abilities, including experience addressing algorithmic or data-intensive challenges.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

- Opportunity to work fully remotely, providing flexibility and work-life balance.

- Note that this is a contractor role without medical benefits or paid leave.

Candidates will undergo a technical interview featuring a live coding challenge lasting approximately 60 minutes to assess their skills and suitability for the role.

Design District Group is seeking a skilled Developer of AI Agents to join our innovative team. This role focuses on designing, developing, and deploying advanced AI agents capable of driving business growth through intelligent marketing strategies. The successful candidate will work closely with product and business teams to create agentic workflows that transform zero-growth scenarios into scalable user acquisition funnels reaching 100,000 users. title: Educational Sales Advisor – UK Market
description_html:
The Educational Advisor will be responsible for speaking with parents across the UK, understanding their children's educational requirements, recommending suitable tutoring solutions, and converting qualified leads into paying clients.

This is a telephone-based sales role and requires excellent spoken English, strong communication skills, and the ability to build rapport and confidently close sales.

Full training will be provided on the UK education system, curriculum, tutoring services, CRM, sales processes, and payment procedures.


Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Qualify incoming leads and identify genuine sales opportunities.
  • Make both inbound and outbound calls to prospective and existing clients.
  • Communicate professionally and confidently with parents across the UK.
  • Understand students' educational needs and recommend appropriate tutoring solutions.
  • Explain Canonical Tutors' services, tutoring programs, and processes to prospective clients.
  • Schedule free trial lessons and appointments.
  • Follow up with prospective clients through telephone calls and professional emails.
  • Build strong relationships with parents and prospective clients.
  • Handle customer questions and address concerns effectively.
  • Convert qualified leads into paying clients and consistently work toward sales targets.
  • Take and process client payments accurately and professionally.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer records in the CRM.
  • Enter, maintain, and update customer information using Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel.
  • Send professional emails and follow up with clients as required.
  • Achieve agreed sales, conversion, and performance targets.
  • Maintain a professional and customer-focused approach at all times.

Requirements

  • UK accent or neutral English accent is required.
  • Excellent spoken English with strong pronunciation and telephone communication skills.
  • Confident and comfortable communicating with customers over the phone.
  • Strong persuasion, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Sales-oriented, target-driven, and motivated by achieving results.
  • Ability to understand customer requirements and recommend suitable solutions.
  • Professional and confident communication style.
  • Ability to handle objections and convert leads into sales.
  • Good written English and ability to draft professional emails.
  • Basic knowledge of Google Sheets and/or Microsoft Excel.
  • Good computer literacy and internet skills.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Punctual, reliable, and professionally presented.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
  • Fresh graduates and recent graduates are encouraged to apply.
  • Previous sales, customer service, telesales, education, or call-center experience will be an advantage but is not mandatory.

Training & Development

No prior knowledge of the UK education system is required. Comprehensive training will be provided on:

  • UK education system and structure.
  • UK curriculum and key stages.
  • Canonical Tutors' services and tutoring programs.
  • Tutoring processes and student requirements.
  • CRM and internal systems.
  • Lead qualification and customer handling.
  • Sales techniques and objection handling.
  • Sales processes and procedures.
  • Client payment processing.
  • Internal reporting and performance tracking.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who:

  • Is highly confident and professional on the phone.
  • Has excellent spoken English and a UK or neutral English accent.
  • Can build strong rapport and trust with parents.
  • Has a natural ability to understand customer needs and recommend suitable solutions.
  • Is persuasive, energetic, and motivated by sales targets.
  • Can confidently handle objections and close sales.
  • Is organized, reliable, and comfortable working in a target-driven environment.
  • Is eager to learn and develop a career in sales and education services.

title: Senior Data Architect (Python · Lakehouse · AI Decisioning)
description_html:
Solvpath is a fast-paced company specializing in cutting-edge technology for post-sale ecommerce processes, including customer support, retention, returns, cancellation deflection, and uncovering new revenue streams. Our solutions increasingly leverage AI to automate these functions. Currently, our data powers reporting for some of the highest-volume direct-to-consumer brands, and we are seeking a skilled professional to take full ownership of this data and architect its future evolution.

Key Responsibilities
You will be responsible for owning the entire data architecture, including how data is structured, stored, and transferred across platforms as we scale. Your role will involve transitioning our capabilities from static reporting and dashboards to real-time, AI-driven decision-making. You will define every KPI formula with precision and ensure complete transparency and accuracy behind every reported number. Additional responsibilities include optimizing speed and bandwidth for handling high-volume data, designing real-time decision logic such as rules, decision trees, and AI models, and leveraging AI to automate data workflows.

Required Qualifications
- Minimum of 7 years’ experience in data engineering or data architecture, with at least 2 years owning a data platform end to end.
- At least 3 years of production experience working with Databricks, Snowflake, or similar lakehouse or data warehouse technologies.
- Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, including API development (experience with Django is preferred).
- Hands-on production experience with decision logic frameworks such as decision trees, scoring systems, or AI/ML models.
- Proven track record of defining metrics and being accountable for their accuracy.
- Regular, daily use of AI tools in your workflow.
- Stability in recent employment, with at least 2 years at your last two employers.

Candidates who do not meet all of these minimum requirements will not be considered.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits
Experience with AWS, ClickHouse, and front-end frameworks like React or Angular is a plus. Familiarity with ecommerce or high-volume consumer data environments is also advantageous.

Joining Solvpath means working on the forefront of AI innovation, having genuine ownership over your projects, and maintaining a direct line of communication with company leadership. This is an opportunity to shape the future of data-driven ecommerce technology in a dynamic and rapidly growing company.

To apply, please prepare your CV and be ready to discuss:
1. A data platform you have owned end to end, including the challenges faced, your solution, and the outcomes achieved.
2. An instance where you identified inaccuracies in a report, how you resolved the issue, and the measures you implemented to prevent recurrence.

We look forward to reviewing applications from candidates who meet the criteria and are excited to contribute to our mission.

title: IT Faculty Member (CS Instructor) - North Karachi
description_html:
Aptech Learning - North Karachi is seeking a dedicated Faculty Member to join their team at the center located near Power House Chorangi. The position requires working hours strictly from 1 PM to 9 PM. This role involves delivering quality education to students in various computer science and IT-related subjects. Candidates who are enthusiastic about teaching and possess a strong foundation in programming and related technologies are encouraged to apply. While prior teaching experience is not mandatory, the ability to effectively communicate and engage with students is essential. Part-time applicants are discouraged, but students awaiting their final results are welcome to apply.

Key Responsibilities:
- Deliver instructional sessions on computer programming, object-oriented programming (OOP), web designing, and database management.
- Utilize modern development tools and frameworks to enhance the learning experience.
- Prepare course materials and assist students in understanding complex technical concepts.
- Foster a positive and interactive classroom environment that encourages student participation and learning.
- Continuously update knowledge of emerging technologies to keep course content relevant.

Required Qualifications:
- A degree in BE, BS, MS, or equivalent in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Cyber Security, Computer Network & Security, Machine Learning, or a closely related field.
- Strong knowledge of computer programming fundamentals, including OOP, web design, and databases.
- Familiarity with contemporary development tools and frameworks.
- Ability and willingness to teach students effectively, regardless of prior teaching experience.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits:
- IT certifications are considered an advantage and will strengthen the candidate’s profile.
- This is a full-time position offering a monthly salary ranging from Rs40,000 to Rs60,000.
- Career growth and promotional opportunities within the organization.
- Annual paid leaves along with other leave benefits.
- A positive, supportive, and hygienic working environment that values employee well-being.
- Annual salary increments based on performance.
- Engagement in employee activities such as award ceremonies, dinners, and picnics to recognize and celebrate achievements.

The role requires the candidate to work on-site at the North Karachi center, ensuring direct interaction with students and team members. This opportunity is ideal for fresh graduates or those new to teaching who are eager to build a career in education and technology.

title: Business Developer Executive
description_html:
ML Bench is looking for a motivated Business Development Executive / Sales Closer with at least two years of experience to join our team. The ideal candidate will confidently manage communications with international clients, conduct professional sales meetings, and successfully convert leads into long-term business opportunities. Strong communication skills, sales expertise, and the ability to independently handle pre-sales activities and client coordination are essential for this role.

Key Responsibilities:
- Conduct discovery calls and sales meetings with international clients to understand their requirements, challenges, and business goals.
- Present ML Bench’s services and solutions in a professional and confident manner.
- Manage client communication, including follow-ups, negotiations, and relationship building.
- Convert inbound and outbound leads into successful projects.
- Collaborate with technical teams to prepare project estimations, proposals, and discuss solutions.
- Maintain accurate CRM records, track the sales pipeline, and ensure regular follow-ups.
- Support lead generation efforts using platforms such as LinkedIn, Upwork, Fiverr, and cold outreach campaigns.

- Minimum of 2 years’ experience in Business Development or IT Sales, preferably within a software house or IT services environment.
- Excellent English communication and presentation skills.

- Good understanding of AI/ML, SaaS, Mobile Applications, Web Development, and UI/UX services.
- Ability to prepare professional proposals, requirement summaries, and sales documentation.

- Prior experience working with international clients from regions such as the USA, UAE, and Europe is a plus.
- Benefits include travel allowance, birthday gifts, opportunities for professional growth with a skilled team, market-competitive salary, and annual company dinners.

This is a full-time, on-site position based at ML Bench, 424, J3 Johar Town, Lahore. The working hours are Monday to Friday, from 9 AM to 6 PM. The salary range for this role is Rs70,000 to Rs110,000 per month.

Applicants should ensure their skills fully match the job description before applying. Candidates must have at least two years of experience in the IT industry, particularly on platforms like Upwork or Fiverr. Only those able to attend an on-site interview should apply.

title: Sr Consultant- Data Analysis
description_html:
TransUnion is seeking a Senior Consultant in Data Analysis to lead advanced analytics initiatives that support identity graph enablement, impact analysis, cloud cost optimization, AI innovation, and the globalization of identity solutions. This hybrid role requires a minimum of two days per week in-office presence, with the remainder performed virtually. The successful candidate will drive data quality improvements, regionalization efforts, and serve as a mentor for junior analysts while effectively communicating insights to business stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead root cause analysis and resolve complex business challenges using advanced analytical techniques, including statistical modeling, machine learning, and AI methodologies to generate actionable insights.
- Develop data-driven recommendations that accelerate decision-making and identify opportunities to automate processes for enhanced operational efficiency.
- Drive initiatives to improve the quality, coverage, accuracy, and precision of the identity graph by analyzing identity resolution performance and recommending enhancements to matching and linking methods.
- Evaluate new data sources to strengthen identity graph capabilities and collaborate with product, engineering, and data teams to implement optimization strategies.
- Design, develop, and maintain dashboards and reporting solutions aligned with key business KPIs, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and usability.
- Provide leadership with clear visibility into operational performance, trends, and strategic initiatives through effective reporting.
- Deliver ad hoc analyses to support business priorities, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and translate complex analytical findings into clear business recommendations and executive communications.
- Analyze cloud infrastructure utilization and spending patterns to identify cost optimization opportunities, develop monitoring frameworks, and support cost governance initiatives.

Required Qualifications

- Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
- Minimum of 5 years’ experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data science, or related fields.
- Proficiency in SQL, BigQuery, Hive, Spark, and other data analysis tools.
- Experience with cloud platforms such as Google Cloud, AWS, or Azure.
- Skilled in data visualization tools including Apache Superset, Google Data Studio, Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
- Hands-on experience with analytical programming languages such as Python or R.
- Strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and stakeholder management abilities.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits

- Expertise in Ontology, Taxonomy, Semantic Web Technologies, and Knowledge Graphs, including ontology design, semantic modeling, metadata management, entity resolution, linked data, graph databases, semantic search, inference engines, and AI-powered knowledge discovery.
- Experience working with Identity Graphs, Customer Identity Resolution, or related data products.
- Familiarity with machine learning, AI/GenAI, and advanced analytics methodologies.
- Knowledge of data governance, data quality frameworks, and managing large-scale data ecosystems.

TransUnion Overview

At TransUnion, we are committed to creating a positive impact through our Workforce for Good initiative, empowering employees to grow, innovate, and contribute to better communities and customer experiences. We foster an environment where associates take charge of their professional development with supportive resources and prioritize work/life flexibility. Join us to work alongside talented professionals, pioneering products, and cutting-edge technology in a culture that values innovation and continuous improvement.

This role offers the opportunity to influence strategic business decisions, enhance operational efficiency through AI-driven solutions, and contribute to the ongoing success and expansion of identity data capabilities globally.

title: Software Quality Assurance Intern
description_html:
Cybersoft North America Inc., established in 1996 as a virtual startup spun off from Applied Research Technologies, Incorporated, has earned a solid reputation as a trusted provider of software solutions across various industries. The company specializes in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Financial Services with an emphasis on Accounts Receivable Management, enterprise workflow-based web applications, IoT solutions, and cross-platform mobile applications. This broad expertise offers team members the opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies and contribute to impactful, real-world projects.

The Software Quality Assurance Intern position is a full-time, on-site role based in Lahore. The intern will play a key role in supporting the QA team by reviewing software requirements, designing and executing test cases, and documenting results to ensure the delivery of high-quality products. Responsibilities include identifying, reporting, and tracking software defects, verifying fixes across multiple releases, and collaborating closely with developers and product teams. The intern will also contribute to the development of test plans and participate in meetings aimed at enhancing software reliability and user experience.

Key Responsibilities
- Assist in reviewing software requirements and specifications to ensure clarity and testability.
- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases based on requirements and user stories.
- Identify, report, and track software defects using bug tracking tools.
- Verify defect fixes and validate software functionality across different releases.
- Collaborate with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to improve product quality.
- Participate in team meetings focused on quality assurance processes and continuous improvement.
- Support the QA team in maintaining comprehensive test documentation and reports.

Required Qualifications
- Strong understanding of Software Quality and Software Quality Assurance principles.
- Proficient analytical skills with keen attention to detail.
- Knowledge of QA processes and methodologies, including test case design and execution.
- Basic understanding of the software development lifecycle and testing concepts.
- Familiarity with bug tracking or issue management tools is advantageous.
- Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
- Currently enrolled in or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits
While not explicitly stated, candidates with prior internship experience or hands-on exposure to QA tools and methodologies will have an added advantage. The role offers an opportunity to gain practical experience in a dynamic work environment, working alongside experienced professionals on innovative projects that span multiple technology domains.

This internship provides a valuable platform for individuals seeking to build a career in software quality assurance, offering exposure to real-world software testing challenges and the chance to develop skills that are highly sought after in the technology sector.

Data engineering or machine learning pipelines
description_html:
We are looking for an experienced Software Engineering Lead to join our team onsite in Islamabad. This senior, full-time position requires over 10 years of software development experience, including leadership roles. The ideal candidate will possess a strong British accent and excellent communication skills to effectively collaborate with UK-based stakeholders. In this role, you will mentor a skilled development team and lead the design, development, and delivery of scalable, secure, and modern web applications. As a technical leader, you will influence software architecture, enforce best practices, and work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions that provide real business value.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Ownership: Lead a team of software engineers in designing and building modern web applications using advanced frontend and backend technologies. Define, document, and enforce coding standards, development processes, and engineering best practices. Take full ownership of features from concept through delivery, translating functional and commercial requirements into robust software designs.

Hands-On Development: Actively contribute to coding, core architecture, and critical feature development. Conduct thorough code reviews to ensure performance, security, and scalability standards are met. Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical challenges in both development and production environments.

Collaboration & Delivery: Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Architects, and QA teams to ensure timely and high-quality feature releases. Mentor and coach team members to foster continuous learning and professional growth. Participate actively in agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release management.

Cloud & DevOps Champion: Utilize Microsoft Azure for application hosting, storage, APIs, serverless functions, and monitoring. Promote DevOps best practices including CI/CD automation, automated testing, and smooth cloud deployments.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
- Over 10 years of software development experience, including at least 2 years in a technical leadership or lead role.
- Strong British accent with excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
- Proficiency in modern JavaScript frameworks such as React.js or Angular.
- Extensive hands-on backend experience with Object-Oriented Programming in Java, C# (.NET / ASP.NET Core), or Python (Django, FastAPI, Flask).
- Practical experience with Microsoft Azure or other cloud platforms (AWS/GCP), including platform services, Git, and automated CI/CD pipelines.
- Deep understanding of software architecture, microservices, and design patterns.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits

Experience with containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes, as well as Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates, is highly desirable. Familiarity with identity and security best practices including OAuth, JWT, and Azure AD is a plus. Exposure to data engineering or machine learning pipelines will be advantageous.

Candidates with experience delivering software in regulated environments such as healthcare or medical device software, including knowledge of FDA design controls, Quality Management Systems (QMS), or requirements traceability, will stand out. Strong soft skills such as proactive ownership, constructive communication, and a mentorship mindset to elevate team capabilities are essential.

The monthly compensation for this role ranges from Rs500,000 to Rs700,000. This position requires working onsite in Islamabad. If you are a motivated technical leader passionate about building impactful software solutions and guiding high-performing teams, we encourage you to apply.

Python Technologies is a leading provider of technology solutions specializing in software engineering, artificial intelligence, digital transformation, and enterprise technology. We enable organizations to leverage modern technologies to improve operational efficiency, foster innovation, and solve complex business challenges. Our engineering teams design, develop, and deploy scalable, secure, and intelligent solutions that align with strategic business objectives. We are seeking an experienced Technical Lead – Forward Deployed Engineering (AI & Digital) for a full-time, onsite position at our DHA Islamabad office. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading the architecture, development, and deployment of advanced AI-powered and enterprise digital solutions, ensuring they meet high standards of scalability, security, and performance.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Engineering Management: Lead and mentor cross-functional teams including software engineers, AI specialists, and cloud experts. Provide technical guidance throughout the software development lifecycle, establish engineering best practices, conduct design and code reviews, and collaborate with stakeholders to define roadmaps and delivery strategies. Proactively identify and mitigate technical risks.

Forward Deployed Engineering: Design, customize, and deploy technology solutions within enterprise environments. Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to translate operational requirements into technical specifications. Develop AI-integrated software solutions, oversee prototyping, production deployment, and post-deployment optimization. Troubleshoot complex technical challenges while ensuring solutions meet business, performance, and security requirements.

Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning Engineering: Lead the development and integration of AI-driven applications, including generative AI using large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and AI orchestration frameworks. Evaluate and integrate AI platforms and services, develop scalable AI pipelines, and work with data teams to ensure data quality and governance. Advocate for responsible AI practices including model evaluation and risk management.

Software Architecture & Application Development: Design scalable, maintainable, and secure architectures for enterprise applications. Lead backend development using Python and frameworks such as FastAPI, Django, or Flask. Implement RESTful APIs, microservices, and distributed systems. Manage integration with cloud services, databases, and third-party platforms. Support application modernization and cloud migration initiatives.

Cloud Engineering & DevOps: Architect and deploy solutions on cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud. Implement containerization using Docker and Kubernetes, establish CI/CD pipelines, and collaborate with infrastructure and security teams to ensure monitoring, logging, and compliance with governance standards. Optimize cloud resource utilization and operational efficiency.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Solution Delivery: Serve as the primary technical liaison for engineering initiatives and enterprise deployments. Partner with product managers, business analysts, and architects to define project scope and technical requirements. Communicate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences, provide technical estimates and documentation, support Agile methodologies, and ensure timely, high-quality delivery.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
- Extensive experience in software engineering, enterprise application development, and technical solution architecture.
- Proven leadership in managing engineering teams and delivering complex enterprise projects.
- Strong proficiency in Python and modern development frameworks.
- Hands-on experience designing APIs, microservices, distributed, and cloud-native systems.
- Expertise in AI/ML technologies, generative AI, and enterprise AI integration.
- Solid understanding of cloud platforms, DevOps practices, and CI/CD pipelines.
- Experience with relational and NoSQL databases.
- Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
- Availability to work full-time onsite at DHA Islamabad during the 6:00 PM – 2:00 AM shift.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits

- Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or related disciplines.
- Experience with AI development frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, and OpenAI APIs.
- Knowledge of vector databases, semantic search, embeddings, and RAG architectures.
- Familiarity with frontend technologies like React, TypeScript, and JavaScript.
- Experience with Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker, and infrastructure automation.
- Understanding of enterprise data engineering platforms and MLOps.
- Relevant certifications in cloud architecture, AI engineering, or software development.
- Competitive monthly salary ranging from Rs180,000 to Rs200,000.
- Work mode is 100% onsite at the DHA Islamabad office, supporting a collaborative and inclusive work environment aligned with Agile methodologies.

Python Technologies is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. Employment decisions are made based on qualifications and business needs, in compliance with applicable laws. Candidates must have at least four years of forward deployment experience and be comfortable working onsite during the specified shift hours.

description_html:
Based in Hyderabad, this role at EY presents an exciting opportunity to advance your career within a global and inclusive environment that values diverse perspectives. As a member of EY’s Financial Accounting Advisory Services (FAAS) team, specifically within Assurance FAAS – Controllership Transformation, you will apply your deep techno-functional expertise to lead transformation initiatives across record to report processes. The focus of this position is on driving comprehensive process improvements rather than direct technology implementation. You will collaborate closely with regional stakeholders to optimize accounting and financial reporting frameworks, contributing to the development of efficient, high-performing client service processes that deliver exceptional value.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead transformation initiatives across record to report areas by leveraging extensive techno-functional knowledge. This includes revenue recognition, accruals, intercompany reconciliation, manual journal entries and automation, asset accounting, chart of accounts, account reconciliation, sub-ledger accounting, consolidation, financial statement production, notes and disclosures, cost accounting, inventory, and profitability analysis.
- Act as a subject matter expert and lead delivery teams on record to report transformation projects, ensuring alignment with client requirements and industry best practices.
- Demonstrate strong understanding of ERP systems such as SAP FI/CO, COPA, SAP BPC, SAP Group Reporting, Oracle Fusion Financial, and their integration with AI-based technologies. Design AI-driven solutions tailored to record to report processes.
- Manage and lead delivery teams or workstreams within large-scale projects to drive successful outcomes.
- Develop expertise in consolidation processes and data structures using tools like SAP Group Reporting, SAP BPC, and Oracle FCCS.
- Drive business development by leading pursuit teams to analyze client challenges, formulate customized solutions, and create compelling proposals.
- Collaborate with market and cross-service line teams to strengthen client relationships and secure new business opportunities.
- Lead internal capability-building initiatives through training sessions and operational improvements within the practice.
- Mentor and manage a team of 5-8 professionals, supporting their growth through coaching, motivation, and career development discussions.
- Maintain flexibility to travel on short notice for client engagements as required.

Required Qualifications

- Chartered Accountant (CA), MBA in Finance with Commerce background, Cost and Works Accountant (CWA), Certified Management Accountant (CMA), Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA), or Master of Commerce (M.Com).
- 7-10 years of relevant consulting experience in record to report transformation, preferably with multinational organizations or Big Four consulting firms.
- Strong expertise in ERP platforms including SAP S/4HANA FI/CO/COPA, SAP Central Finance, Oracle Fusion Finance, and Oracle Netsuite.
- Experience with digital finance solutions such as Blackline, Trintech, High Radius, and various Robotic Process Automation (RPA) tools.
- Knowledge of AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and analytics solutions relevant to finance, particularly in record to report processes.
- Proven ability to conduct current state (As-Is) and future state (To-Be) analyses, process and data optimization, data analytics, and data management.
- Excellent communication skills, strong project management capabilities, and demonstrated leadership of diverse, geographically dispersed teams.
- Strong business development, solution conceptualization, and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to work effectively under pressure, manage ambiguity, and take entrepreneurial ownership of challenges and solutions.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits

- Experience working with international clients is highly desirable.
- Exposure to multinational consulting environments or Big Four firms is advantageous.
- Opportunity to contribute to EY’s mission of building a better working world by helping clients transform and operate with trust and innovation.
- Competitive salary package and the chance to grow within a supportive, technology-enabled, and inclusive global network.

description_html:
A Research Assistant provides vital support to research projects across various disciplines by collecting, organizing, analyzing, and interpreting data. This role involves conducting literature reviews, preparing reports, maintaining accurate records, and assisting senior researchers with project activities. Research Assistants contribute to the design of research tools, data collection, and the presentation of findings, ensuring adherence to ethical standards and confidentiality.

Key Responsibilities:
- Conduct literature reviews using academic journals, books, and databases.
- Collect and organize qualitative and quantitative data.
- Assist in designing questionnaires, surveys, and research instruments.
- Analyze data and prepare summaries, reports, and presentations.
- Maintain detailed and confidential research records.
- Support senior researchers with project planning and implementation.

Required Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field.
- Strong research, analytical, and communication skills.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
- Familiarity with research methodologies and data collection techniques.

---

In Education, the Research Assistant supports studies on teaching methods, student outcomes, curriculum development, and educational policies. Responsibilities include reviewing educational literature, collecting data from academic institutions, conducting interviews and surveys, analyzing assessment data, and supporting program evaluations. Candidates should hold a degree in Education, Educational Psychology, Social Sciences, or related fields, with knowledge of educational research methods and strong organizational skills.

---

In Medical and Healthcare research, the assistant aids clinical studies, public health investigations, and medical data analysis. Tasks include data collection, literature review, participant recruitment, documentation, and report preparation while strictly following research ethics and patient confidentiality. A degree in Public Health, Biology, Medical Sciences, Nursing, or related disciplines is required, along with attention to detail and knowledge of statistical software.

---

Social Sciences Research Assistants support studies in sociology, psychology, political science, economics, and anthropology. Key duties involve conducting literature reviews, designing surveys, collecting and transcribing qualitative data, and assisting with statistical and thematic analyses. Candidates should have a degree in social sciences, knowledge of qualitative and quantitative methods, and familiarity with tools like SPSS or NVivo.

---

Agricultural Research Assistants contribute to projects on crop production, soil health, plant diseases, and sustainable farming. Responsibilities include assisting with field experiments, collecting environmental data, monitoring crop growth, supporting lab testing, and preparing technical reports. A degree in Agriculture, Agronomy, Soil Science, or related fields is essential, along with willingness to work in field and lab settings.

---

Environmental Science Research Assistants support studies on climate change, pollution, biodiversity, and sustainability. They collect environmental samples, assist with quality assessments, review regulations, analyze datasets, and prepare reports. Candidates should hold a degree in Environmental Science, Biology, Geography, or related fields, with knowledge of sampling methods and analytical skills. Familiarity with GIS or statistical software is advantageous.

---

In Computer Science and IT, Research Assistants work on software development, AI, machine learning, cybersecurity, and data science projects. Duties include reviewing technical literature, data cleaning, algorithm development, experiment documentation, and maintaining research code.
